aboutParagraphs: InnerAnimalMedia builds developer tooling, autonomous agent infrastructure, and multi-domain publishing systems designed around clarity, determinism, and editorial restraint.

Across the AgentSam runtime, the ASBD design system, and the IAPJ theme package, every layer shares one rule: keep contracts explicit, eliminate fragile runtime assumptions, and pair generative capability with verifiable engineering discipline.
This platform serves as both our public engineering blog and a reusable portfolio and theme template for multi-domain publishing.
